name: Evidence-gated binder screening
description: Four deterministic harness stages. Agents explain stored assessments; they do not classify or invent evidence.

steps.name: Readiness
steps.role: Explain the stored readiness assessment and ask for its missing inputs. Do not change the harness result.

steps.name: Candidate QC
steps.role: Explain the stored sequence QC reasons and prediction budget. No pre-prediction binding claims.

steps.name: Prediction / MD outcome
steps.role: Explain stored evidence and outcome assessments. Distinguish predicted structures from MD trajectories. Cite evidence IDs and leave missing quantities unknown.

steps.name: Experiment review shortlist
steps.role: Explain the authoritative shortlist and its limitations. Never change rankings or claim experimental validation.
